goal: The events landing exposes all venue cards through a clear working slider, and every affected place-card checkmark is visually centered and consistently sized.

intent_model.literal_request: Fix the events slider because there are more than three places, and center and resize the V marks inside circles or squares on place cards.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Visitors can browse the actual event inventory without an artificial short rail and the card UI looks professionally aligned.
likely_rejections: Only the visible screenshot is patched
The rail still contains only four records
The V is mathematically but not optically centered
The fix hurts loading or other card actions

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Do not cap the general venue rail to the first four records.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Rendered rail count must equal the loaded event catalog count and remain navigable.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Browse event venues and understand feature cards.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose a venue or recognize a supported feature.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the venue card or continue sliding.

natural_destination: Events landing and event detail pages

facts.claim: The current public general event section renders only four venue cards.
facts.evidence: Public version 534 DOM and app/events/page.tsx eventPlaces.slice(0, 4).

facts.claim: Event detail feature cards use a raw text checkmark before their label.
facts.evidence: app/events/place/client-page.tsx and the public event-2 route.

assumptions.claim: The user's V complaint refers to the event place feature-card family observed in the same events context.
assumptions.validation: Inspect both event-level and room-level feature cards at desktop and mobile; keep the primitive scoped to that family.

requirements.statement: The general events rail contains every loaded venue and exposes overflow through working controls.
Affected checkmarks use a fixed SVG box with centered and consistent geometry.
The repair preserves existing card, contact, image and availability behavior.

acceptance_checks.setup: Events landing with more cards than fit in the viewport
acceptance_checks.action: Load the page and activate the next control
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The rail contains the full catalog, starts at the correct edge and advances to additional venue cards.

acceptance_checks.setup: Rail moved away from the initial boundary
acceptance_checks.action: Reload and resize desktop to 390px and back
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The rail resets to the logical start and remains navigable without page overflow.

acceptance_checks.setup: Event feature and room feature cards rendered
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each check SVG is centered in a fixed circle or square and uses the approved size at desktop and mobile.

acceptance_checks.action: Exercise gallery, whole-card link, phone and WhatsApp boundaries
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No action is lost, nested or redirected by the rail/checkmark repair.

acceptance_checks.action: Compare changed files with public baseline
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Only the requested event rail and feature-check families differ and production stays on version 534.

authorization_boundary: Local implementation and verification are authorized; public deployment requires an explicit current approval.
